_comment: Per-project **CLOSE** gate. It runs at the END of a phase, after the evidence pass has verified each acceptance criterion and ticked the boxes. Run it explicitly: `node <plugin>/scripts/checkpoint.mjs --manifest docs/checkpoints/checkpoint-close.json`. build-phase writes a per-phase copy at docs/checkpoints/phase-<n>-close.json with the AC row scoped to that phase via `match`, and that per-phase copy is what phase-complete runs.
_why_two_files: Split from checkpoint.json so the acceptance-criteria row runs only once the evidence for it exists. One combined gate fails by construction on every first close, and the only way through is to tick the boxes to go green — evidence-then-tick inverted into tick-to-go-green.
_scoping: This whole-project copy demands the WHOLE checklist ticked, which is right for the final checkpoint and wrong mid-plan. A per-phase copy adds "match": "AC-00[1-4]" (this phase's criteria only), or an early phase fails on criteria later phases still own.
_close_record: A per-phase copy also doubles as the close RECORD: it is scaffolded with "closed": false and phase-complete flips it to true, only after this gate exits zero. scripts/state.mjs reads a phase as closed when that file exists WITHOUT "closed": false. This project-level copy carries no "closed" key, because it records no single phase.
